entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
This is completely unacceptable! I bought this jersey and it's the wrong size. I need to return it right now. Your sizing charts are a joke.

I'm very sorry to hear about the trouble with your order. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is the issue with the jersey a matter of preference with the fit, or is there a defect with the item?

What are you talking about? It's too tight! That's the issue! I can't even breathe in this thing. I want an exchange for a size that actually fits a human being. Get me your manager if you can't handle this.
I understand your frustration, and I assure you, I can help you with this. There's no need to speak with a manager. Let me just quickly review the return policy for your item.
You'd better. Because I'm about to post a review on every single website about how VeloFit sells doll clothes to adults. This is the last time I ever buy from you.

I appreciate your patience. Okay, I've just confirmed it. It looks like standard apparel items, like your jersey, have a 90-day return window. Since you received it 12 days ago, you are well within that period. We can definitely process an exchange or a full refund.
Well, finally! About time. So how does the exchange work? Don't make this complicated.

It's a very simple process. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. You just need to print it, package the jersey, and drop it at any post office. Would you like me to set up the exchange for the next size up?
Yes. Send me a large. And it had better be fast.

Of course. I have put the order in for a size large. We will ship it out as soon as our warehouse receives the original item. You should see that email with the return label within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
